title: The Human Robot Social Interaction (HSRI) Dataset: Benchmarking Foundational Models’ Social Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the social reasoning capabilities of foundational models, specifically regarding social errors and competencies in human-robot interactions. While it includes 'Social Norms' as an attribute, this refers to social etiquette and conversational rules rather than an evaluation or benchmark of religion, faith, or formal ethical systems.
